发现高价值帖子：《一天半时间赚了 5 万元的经历》。抓几篇关键原帖。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 300000, "code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",
 "// 用 RSS/JSON feed 拿主题 id 更可靠",
 "const feeds=[",
 " ['feed_p1','https://www.v2ex.com/go/sidehustle?p=4'],",
 " ['feed_p2','https://www.v2ex.com/go/sidehustle?p=5'],",
 " ['json_feed','https://www.v2ex.com/feed/sidehustle.json']",
 "];",
 "let i=0;",
 "function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms)});}",
 "async function next(){",
 " if(i>=feeds.length) return;",
 " const t=feeds[i++];",
 " const pu=new URL(t[1]);",
 " await sleep(i===1?2000:9000);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:t[1],headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept-Language':'zh-CN,zh;q=0.9'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',async function(){",
 " let b=Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8');",
 " if(t[0]==='json_feed'){",
 " try{ const j=JSON.parse(b); console.log('JSON FEED items:', j.length); for(const it of j.slice(0,25)){ console.log('-', it.id, '|', it.title); } }catch(e){ console.log('json parse fail', b.substring(0,200)); }",
 " await next(); return;",
 " }",
 " b=b.replace(/<script[\\s\\S]*?<\\/script>/g,' ').replace(/<style[\\s\\S]*?<\\/style>/g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ');",
 " b=b.replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,String.fromCharCode(34)).replace(/\\s+/g,' ');",
 " console.log('===== '+t[0]+' OK '+res.statusCode+' len='+b.length);",
 " console.log(b.substring(0,2500));",
 " await next();",
 " });",
 " }).on('error',async function(e){console.log('===== '+t[0]+' ERR '+e.message); await next();});",
 "}",
 "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-bounty6.cjs", content: js });

console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 10000));

  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",

  "const feeds=[",

  "  ['json_feed','https://www.v2ex.com/feed/sidehustle.json']",
  "];",

  "      b=b.replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,String.fromCharCode(34)).replace(/\\s+/g,' ');",
  "      console.log('===== '+t[0]+' OK '+res.statusCode+' len='+b.length);",
  "      console.log(b.substring(0,2500));",
  "      await next();",
  "    });",
  "  }).on('error',async function(e){console.log('===== '+t[0]+' ERR '+e.message); await next();});",
  "}",
  "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-bounty6.cjs", content: js });
